title: Long-term Monitoring of Children and Youths who Have Experienced Sudden Death of Peers
what_it_is: Long-term Monitoring of Children and Youths who Have Experienced Sudden Death of Peers

sections.label: Schools support affected students' parents
sections.summary: Schools work with parents of affected students, sharing how to give emotional support, while teachers monitor students' well-being and distress signs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Schools also work closely with the parents of the affected students and share with them how they can provide emotional support for their children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Teachers continue to monitor the well-being of the students and look out for signs of distress.

sections.label: Referrals to counsellors and professionals
sections.summary: Students needing more support are referred to school counsellors, then medical professionals, and the principal ascertains facts before breaking news of a student's sudden death.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: If teachers or parents find that the students require further support, they will refer the students to the school counsellor.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All school counsellors are equipped with the knowledge and skills to help students cope with grief and loss.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: If the students continue to show signs of distress or have difficulty coping, they will be referred for follow-up with medical professionals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: When the sudden death of a student occurs, the principal will ascertain the facts of the incident before breaking the news to the staff as soon as possible.

sections.label: Prepping teachers and sharing information
sections.summary: Teachers are prepped for possible reactions and advised on supporting students, with information updated and shared to counter rumours or misinformation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Teachers will also be prepped for possible reactions and they will be advised on how they can better support students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: But I want to assure Ms Joan Pereira that information will be updated and shared as and when available.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is important to ensure that the principal, staff and teachers in school will have the information at hand to counter or even dispel any rumours or misinformation.
